items.q: What is the next number in 3, 6, 12, 24, …?
items.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in 3, 6, 12, 24, …?
items.explain: Each term is double the one before: 24 × 2 = 48.
items.explainAf: Elke term is dubbel die vorige een: 24 × 2 = 48.

items.q: Describe the rule for the pattern 5, 9, 13, 17, …
items.qAf: Beskryf die reël vir die patroon 5, 9, 13, 17, …
items.explain: The terms go up by 4 each time, so the rule is to add 4.
items.explainAf: Die terme styg elke keer met 4, dus is die reël om 4 by te tel.

items.explain: The nth term is 2n, so the 10th term is 2 × 10 = 20.
items.explainAf: Die n-de term is 2n, dus is die 10de term 2 × 10 = 20.

items.q: Figure 1 has 4 matchsticks, figure 2 has 7 and figure 3 has 10. How many matchsticks are in figure 4?
items.qAf: Figuur 1 het 4 vuurhoutjies, figuur 2 het 7 en figuur 3 het 10. Hoeveel vuurhoutjies is in figuur 4?

items.q: The number of dots in figure n is 3n. How many dots are in figure 6?
items.qAf: Die aantal kolletjies in figuur n is 3n. Hoeveel kolletjies is in figuur 6?

items.q: Figure 1 has 1 square, figure 2 has 5 squares and figure 3 has 9 squares. How many squares are in figure 10?
items.qAf: Figuur 1 het 1 vierkant, figuur 2 het 5 vierkante en figuur 3 het 9 vierkante. Hoeveel vierkante is in figuur 10?
items.explain: The pattern goes up by 4, so the rule is 4n − 3. For n = 10: 40 − 3 = 37.
items.explainAf: Die patroon styg met 4, dus is die reël 4n − 3. Vir n = 10: 40 − 3 = 37.
